ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the perimeter of square $ABCD$ is 40. Point $P$ is a moving point on the diagonal $AC$ of square $ABCD$. Perpendiculars are drawn from point $P$ to $AB$ and $BC$, with the feet of the perpendiculars being $E$ and $F$, respectively. Prove that the quadrilateral $PEBF$ is a rectangle.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Proof:\\
Since $PE\perp AB$ and $PF\perp BC$,\\
it follows that $\angle PEB=\angle PFB=90^\circ$.\\
Furthermore, since $ABCD$ is a square,\\
it follows that $\angle ABC=90^\circ$.\\
Therefore, the quadrilateral PEBF is a \boxed{rectangle}.
